items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Well every year I played his daughter, Devil Jude, dance.

ctx.x: run them in the river with it. That's right. What do you think makes the difference between the young man and the old man?

What do you think makes the difference? I think the old man know what they're doing better than the youngsters. The youngsters, you see the youngsters, they take and they want to do, they want to do too many things. It's only one thing you can do when you're playing music. Sit down and try to play a straight lead and play your horn right. With all that monkey shine, you don't be doing that. See them jumping off the bandstand with a horn in your mind, enough for you to fall off a stadium and cripple yourself with…
